upstream.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

classification.analysis: Ponytail is a prompt/skill pack that makes AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and ~15 others) prefer the smallest correct change over generated boilerplate, by injecting a 'laziness ladder' (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native feature, one-liner) before the agent writes code. It ships as skills/rules/hooks for each supported CLI/editor and includes its own benchmark suite measuring LOC/token/cost reduction against a no-skill baseline. Aimed at developers who find agentic coding tools over-engineer simple tasks; rapidly growing adoption (100k+ stars in weeks).

use_cases.title: Stop an AI coding agent from over-engineering simple changes
Install a lazy-senior-dev skill into Claude Code or Codex
Benchmark agent code output size across models
